description.zh: 通过故事、预测、模拟和动手挑战，探索摩擦力如何产生热量！
description.en: Explore how friction creates heat through story, prediction, simulation, and hands-on challenges!

topic.zh: 物质科学 > 力的作用 > 摩擦力

title.en: Rub Your Hands, Warm Your Hands

subtitle.zh: 一个关于摩擦力的小故事

imageAlt.zh: 小明在操场上搓手取暖
imageAlt.en: Xiao Ming rubbing hands on the playground

paragraphs.zh: 冬天的早晨，小明在操场上冻得直哆嗦。
paragraphs.en: On a cold winter morning, Xiao Ming was shivering on the playground.

paragraphs.zh: 他把两只手掌合在一起，快速地搓了起来。
paragraphs.en: He pressed his palms together and rubbed them quickly back and forth.

paragraphs.zh: 神奇的事情发生了——手掌变暖了！
paragraphs.en: Something magical happened - his palms felt warm!

paragraphs.zh: 可是，热量是从哪里来的呢？
paragraphs.en: But where did the heat come from?

paragraphs.zh: 让我们一起来探索"摩擦力"的秘密吧！
paragraphs.en: Let's explore the secret of "friction" together!

hint.zh: 试试搓搓你自己的双手，感受一下温度的变化！
hint.en: Try rubbing your own hands together and feel the temperature change!

question.zh: 用手快速搓桌子表面，手会感觉怎样？
question.en: If you rub the desk quickly with your hand, how will your hand feel?

explanation.zh: 摩擦会产生热量！两个表面接触并移动时，微小的原子互相碰撞，产生了热能。
explanation.en: Friction generates heat! When two surfaces touch and slide, tiny atoms collide and produce thermal energy.

question.zh: 哪个表面搓起来更费力？
question.en: Which surface takes more effort to rub?

imageAlt.zh: 光滑玻璃和粗糙砂纸对比

explanation.zh: 粗糙的表面有更多凹凸不平的地方，原子之间的碰撞更多，所以摩擦力更大！
explanation.en: Rough surfaces have more bumps, causing more atomic collisions, which means greater friction!

question.en: If you rub faster, the temperature will...

explanation.zh: 搓得越快，原子碰撞越剧烈，产生的热量就越多，温度升得越高。
explanation.en: Faster rubbing means more intense atomic collisions, producing more heat, so the temperature rises higher.

instructions.zh: 拖动木块来回摩擦，观察原子碰撞和温度变化
instructions.en: Drag the block back and forth to observe atomic collisions and temperature changes

question.zh: 把这些表面按摩擦力从小到大排列：
question.en: Rank these surfaces from least to most friction:

imageAlt.zh: 冰面、木头、砂纸三种表面

explanation.zh: 冰面最光滑（摩擦力最小），砂纸最粗糙（摩擦力最大），木头在中间。表面越粗糙，原子之间的碰撞越多！
explanation.en: Ice is the smoothest (least friction), sandpaper is the roughest (most friction), and wood is in between. Rougher surfaces cause more atomic collisions!

statement.zh: 搓手的时候手会变热，这是因为摩擦产生了热量
statement.en: When you rub your hands together they get warm because friction produces heat

explanation.zh: 正确！当两个表面互相摩擦时，表面的微小粒子（原子）互相碰撞，碰撞产生了热能，所以手会变热。
explanation.en: Correct! When two surfaces rub together, tiny particles (atoms) on the surfaces collide, and these collisions produce thermal energy, making your hands warm.

statement.zh: 在冰面上滑动比在砂纸上滑动会产生更多的热量
statement.en: Sliding on ice produces more heat than sliding on sandpaper

explanation.zh: 错误！砂纸更粗糙，摩擦力更大，产生的热量更多。冰面很光滑，摩擦力小，产生的热量很少。
explanation.en: False! Sandpaper is rougher with more friction, so it produces more heat. Ice is smooth with little friction, producing very little heat.

statement.zh: 搓得越快，产生的热量越多

explanation.zh: 正确！速度越快，原子碰撞越剧烈、越频繁，产生的热能越多，温度上升越快。
explanation.en: Correct! Higher speed means more intense and frequent atomic collisions, producing more thermal energy and a faster temperature rise.

subtitle.zh: 用文字和语言表达你的科学发现
subtitle.en: Express your scientific discoveries through language

subtitle.zh: 用你学到的知识写一段话
subtitle.en: Write a paragraph about what you learned

template.zh: 今天我学到了关于摩擦力的知识。摩擦力是______。当两个表面互相摩擦时，______。表面越粗糙，______。我做了一个实验：______。我发现______。
template.en: Today I learned about friction. Friction is ______. When two surfaces rub together, ______. The rougher the surface, ______. I did an experiment: ______. I discovered ______.

tips.zh: 先写你观察到了什么（现象）
再写你觉得为什么会这样（原因）
tips.en: Then, write why you think it happened (reason)

placeholder.zh:
请在这里写下你的科学发现……

提示：可以用"首先……然后……最后……"来组织你的文字。
placeholder.en:
Write about your science discovery here...

Tip: Use "First... Then... Finally..." to organize your writing.

vocabulary.sentenceZh: 摩擦力让我的手变热了。

vocabulary.sentenceEn: The surface of sandpaper is rough.
The ice surface is very smooth.

title.zh: 动手实验：摩擦力大比拼

subtitle.zh: 现在轮到你亲手验证了！
subtitle.en: Now it's your turn to test it for real!

intro.zh: 你在模拟中看到了摩擦力如何让原子抖动、产生热量。现在用真实的材料来做一次实验，看看现实和模拟是不是一样！
intro.en: You saw in the simulation how friction makes atoms vibrate and produce heat. Now use real materials to experiment and see if reality matches the simulation!

curriculum.zh: 课标对应：物质科学 > 力的作用 > 摩擦力（3-4年级）

note.en: A few cents at hardware store

experimentSteps.en: Tie the rubber band around the wooden block

experimentSteps.zh: 在光滑桌面上拉着木块滑动，观察橡皮筋拉长了多少厘米
experimentSteps.en: Drag the block across the smooth desk — observe how many cm the rubber band stretches

experimentSteps.zh: 把砂纸铺在桌上，再拉一次——橡皮筋拉得更长了！
experimentSteps.en: Put sandpaper on the desk and drag again — the rubber band stretches more!

experimentSteps.zh: 换成毛巾铺在桌上，再试一次
experimentSteps.en: Replace sandpaper with a towel and try again

experimentSteps.zh: 用手摸一摸滑动后的木块底部——感觉温度变化了吗？
experimentSteps.en: Touch the bottom of the block after sliding — can you feel any temperature change?

verify.zh: 做完实验后，回到模拟中切换不同表面（木头/砂纸/冰面），看看模拟结果和你的实验是不是一致！
verify.en: After the experiment, go back to the simulation and switch surfaces (wood/sandpaper/ice) to compare!
